t: What he said with the mountain in view
a: مَا يَسُرُّنِي أَنَّ عِنْدِي مِثْلَ أُحُدٍ هَذَا ذَهَبًا، تَمْضِي عَلَىَّ ثَالِثَةٌ وَعِنْدِي مِنْهُ دِينَارٌ، إِلاَّ شَيْئًا أُرْصِدُهُ لِدَيْنٍ
p: Mā yasurrunī anna ʿindī mithla Uḥudin hādhā dhahabā, tamḍī ʿalayya thālithatun wa ʿindī minhu dīnār, illā shayʾan urṣiduhu li-dayn
m: It would not please me to have gold like this Uhud, and have a third night pass with a single dinar of it still with me, except something I set aside for a debt.
